import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

p='protein.shape.q1.pdb'
atoms=[]; ca=[]
for line in open(p):
    if line.startswith('ATOM'):
        atom=line[12:16].strip(); chain=line[21]
        x=float(line[30:38]); y=float(line[38:46]); z=float(line[46:54])
        atoms.append((chain,atom,x,y,z))
        if atom=='CA': ca.append((chain,x,y,z))

def arr(sel=None, only_ca=True):
    src=ca if only_ca else [(c,a,x,y,z) for c,a,x,y,z in atoms]
    pts=[]; ch=[]
    for rec in src:
        if only_ca:
            c,x,y,z=rec
        else:
            c,a,x,y,z=rec
        if sel is None or c in sel:
            pts.append([x,y,z]); ch.append(c)
    return np.array(pts), np.array(ch)

sets=[('ALL','ABCDEF'),('ABC','ABC'),('DEF','DEF'),('A','A'),('D','D'),('small','BCEF')]
axes=[('XY',np.eye(3)[:,[0,1]]),('XZ',np.eye(3)[:,[0,2]]),('YZ',np.eye(3)[:,[1,2]])]
colors={c:plt.cm.tab10(i) for i,c in enumerate('ABCDEF')}
fig,axs=plt.subplots(len(sets),3,figsize=(12,18))
for i,(name,sel) in enumerate(sets):
    pts,ch=arr(sel)
    for j,(an,mat) in enumerate(axes):
        ax=axs[i,j]
        uv=pts@mat
        for c in sorted(set(ch)):
            m=ch==c
            ax.scatter(uv[m,0], uv[m,1], s=2, color=colors[c], alpha=.8, linewidths=0)
            # connect CA in residue order by chain
            uvc=uv[m]
            ax.plot(uvc[:,0],uvc[:,1], color=colors[c], alpha=.3, lw=.7)
        ax.set_title(f'{name} {an}')
        ax.set_aspect('equal','box'); ax.axis('off')
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('projection_axes.png', dpi=200)
plt.close(fig)

# PCA views for each set
fig,axs=plt.subplots(len(sets),3,figsize=(12,18))
for i,(name,sel) in enumerate(sets):
    pts,ch=arr(sel)
    X=pts-pts.mean(0)
    _,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(X, full_matrices=False)
    comps=vh.T
    pairs=[(0,1),(0,2),(1,2)]
    for j,pair in enumerate(pairs):
        ax=axs[i,j]
        uv=X@comps[:,pair]
        for c in sorted(set(ch)):
            m=ch==c; uvc=uv[m]
            ax.scatter(uvc[:,0],uvc[:,1],s=2,color=colors[c],alpha=.8,linewidths=0)
            ax.plot(uvc[:,0],uvc[:,1], color=colors[c], alpha=.3, lw=.7)
        ax.set_title(f'{name} PC{pair[0]+1}{pair[1]+1}')
        ax.set_aspect('equal','box'); ax.axis('off')
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('projection_pca.png', dpi=200); plt.close(fig)

print('saved projection_axes.png projection_pca.png')

import numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
coords=[]; chains=[]
for line in open('protein.shape.q1.pdb'):
    if line.startswith('ATOM'):
        coords.append([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])]); chains.append(line[21])
coords=np.array(coords); coords-=coords.mean(0); chains=np.array(chains)
rng=np.random.default_rng(4)
_,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(coords,full_matrices=False); C=vh.T
bases=[]; names=[]
for pair in [(0,1),(0,2),(1,2)]: bases.append(C[:,pair]); names.append('PC'+''.join(str(i+1) for i in pair))
for i in range(2500):
    M=rng.normal(size=(3,3)); Q,_=np.linalg.qr(M); bases.append(Q[:,:2]); names.append(f'rand{i}')
idxs=[1016,1221,1024,147,1120,88,2071,931,468]
colors={c:plt.cm.tab10(i) for i,c in enumerate('ABCDEF')}
fig,axs=plt.subplots(3,3,figsize=(12,12))
for ax,idx in zip(axs.ravel(),idxs):
    uv=coords@bases[idx]
    for c in sorted(set(chains)):
        m=chains==c
        ax.scatter(uv[m,0],uv[m,1],s=.25,color=colors[c],alpha=.5,linewidths=0)
    ax.set_title(f'{idx} {names[idx]}'); ax.set_aspect('equal','box'); ax.axis('off')
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('top_scored_orientations.png',dpi=200); plt.close(fig)
